name: Smart and Skilled fee-free training for refugees and asylum seekers
summary: Refugees, asylum seekers and partners of humanitarian visa holders may study Certificate I to IV fee-free in NSW.
who: Refugees or asylum seekers doing a Smart and Skilled Certificate I to IV course.
Eligible partners of humanitarian visa holders, for training from 1 July 2021.

source.label: Skills NSW: Fee-free training for disadvantaged students

evidence.quote: This now includes eligible partners of humanitarian visa holders, for any training that commences from 1 July 2021 onwards.
you may be eligible for fee-free training under Smart and Skilled
